name: Wayne County, MI
findings: Wayne County has 6,282 nonprofit organizations. 2,263 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,723 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Wayne County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few research and think tank organizations list public events
observations.text: 15 research and think tank organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 50 would.

confidence.text: Based on 50 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through research and think tank groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Wayne County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 2,541 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
